note: Alberta Parks campground in Sheep River Provincial Park, 21 km west of Turner Valley on Hwy 546, run by Kananaskis Campground Services. Well-treed sites in pine forest above the Sheep River, with a playground; firewood and shower tokens sold from a truck. Potable water at the Sheep Administration RV dump (year-round). Separate Sandy McNabb Equestrian campground nearby. --Claude
